verdict.rationale: dLocal documents Smart Fields for merchants that are not fully PCI DSS compliant to collect card data securely, plus a hosted Checkout Redirect. Saved cards are charged by `card_id` token, and merchants can rely on dLocal's PCI Level 1 status and complete the relevant SAQ, which delivers the core scope-reduction story. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that raw card data never reaches merchant servers, detail on Smart Fields tokenization mechanics and which SAQ type applies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
